## Problem

Describe the single observable problem this change addresses.

## A/R invariants

- Which A facts are created by deterministic code?
- Which model or user statements remain R?
- How is exact source text protected?

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated deterministic tests
- [ ] Ran `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] Used temporary or synthetic memory
- [ ] Updated documentation when a public contract changed
- [ ] Added third-party license information when needed
- [ ] Checked that no credential or private conversation was included

## Cost

Describe changes to model calls, context size, latency or storage.
